title: 689. Maximum Swap

examples.explanation: Exchanging the 2 with the 7 yields the largest reachable value 7236.
The digits are already in the best order, so no exchange improves the value.
Swapping the small 3 with the later 8 gives 98863.

hints: Record the last position of each digit 0-9.
Scan from the most significant digit and look for a larger digit appearing later.
Swap at most once: the earliest improvable position with the largest possible later digit.
